name: Kedamono Aniki no Aishikata
original_name: ケダモノ兄貴の愛しかた
source:
An older brother was bitten while trying to save his sister from a mysterious beast, and something strange happens to him.

"If you leave it as it is, that person will turn into a beast." 

The way to save your brother is to fulfill your desires !? Do you abandon your brother? Do you do your best to help?
